papers.title: Think Before You Grid-Search: Floor-First Triage for LLM Serving
papers.abstract: LLM serving optimization typically benchmarks many configurations and reaches for heavy profilers when latency targets are missed. We argue for the reverse discipline: estimation is the analytical layer of profiling -- without it, optimization degenerates to grid search. Floor First is a residual-driven triage workflow. papers.abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite Internet introduces rapid path variability, intermittent capacity shifts, and non-terrestrial delay dynamics that challenge transport-layer congestion control. Although Bottleneck Bandwidth and Round-trip propagation time (BBR) achieves high throughput in such environments, its aggressive bandwidth probing can cause excessive retransmissions and unstable pacing over LEO links.
